system.description:
You can exert minor influence on shadows, darkening them or making them move unnaturally. Expend a Blood Trait and choose how to deploy your shadows. Twisting them in your immediate area grants one extra Trait for challenges of stealth and ranged combat, or you can use them to appear more menacing, granting an additional Trait for intimidation-related challenges.

Alternatively, you can have the shadows drag and unnerve someone else. While under their influence, the target gains the Negative Trait Clumsy. Weak mortals may be overcome by these shadows — if a mortal has three or fewer current Physical Traits, he begins to suffocate, losing one Physical Trait per turn, then one health level per turn until the shadows smother him. Shadow Play lasts for one scene.
